scope: Reuse already-acquired authoritative PAPER exact-size reverse-quote valuations with original typed SOL/USD receipts in compatible prospective runner and entry-gate cases; audit secondary quota coverage without increasing market calls or activating runtime.
implementation: The authoritative PAPER get_exit_cash_mark snapshots its original pre-await quote-start clock and shares only a successfully checked original quote and typed FX after unchanged portfolio/SQL generation checks.

Both research consumers independently reconstruct each eligible case or arm's own financial basis and owner. Token, exact raw remaining quantity, original request/receipt chronology, public route and typed FX freshness must match. No donor money, financial peaks, fill, SQL mutation or quote reservation is copied.

Pending or closed arms cannot use the valuation hook. A newly-created financial exit intent requires a separate subsequent exact-size execution quote. Same-time duplicate observations cannot renew counts or replace conflicting original cash marks.

Entry reuse validates the original plan identity, financial policy, current declared exit identity and original case identity. Malformed plan identities cannot leave the plan directory. Malformed sibling cases are skipped without modifying them or blocking a valid case.

Each research component is independently isolated from primary cash valuation failures. A secondary storage/component failure cannot abort the other consumer or change the original primary portfolio/mark.

Paired research no longer defaults to a separate spot-price HTTP request, which cannot prove executable cash. Explicit injected diagnostics remain supported; the original typed FX callback is passed through. The shared one-extra-quote-per-minute quota, priority and conservative alternation remain unchanged.

coverage: four Swap V2 families in both banks
own owners/costs and unchanged quote quota
quote predating or lacking request start
uncapped extreme original cash valuations with residual tail
actual primary SQL/await generation checks and secondary failure isolation
no default paired spot call and original injected FX forwarding

capacity_analysis.model: Synthetic continuous demand with actual forward_budget.claim, runner-first ordering, oldest group within owner, strict two-owner alternation, isolated TemporaryDirectory, 384 ticks per scenario.
limitations: These are capacity scenarios, not actual trades, token counts or a current observed market-coverage estimate.
No provider failure, pending fill, new entry or primary reuse is assumed; real coverage may differ.
Quota safety is not exhaustive opportunity coverage. Financial acceptance must reject incomplete own observations, not relax the coverage contract.
Primary reuse helps only while token and remaining raw quantity match; rejected tokens without a primary position may not benefit.
